designDecisionsAndRationale: One RateLimitUsageService per process: Runtime.swift binds one and passes it to the single MachineDashboardRouter, which also serves the delegating DashboardRouter(machineRouter:) and the desktop window; the menu bar shares its service with its own router, so all callers share the 60 s throttle.

The production factory composes ClaudeRateLimitFetcher, CodexRateLimitFetcher, one URLSessionRateLimitTransport and CodexRateLimitSessionFallback from the passed environment only, so it is testable with a temporary HOME and does no I/O.

Menu-bar refresh() becomes refreshSnapshot() then refreshRateLimitsIfNeeded(), so rate limits refresh independently of snapshot early returns (PR-M2, QA decision 5); new members live in MenuBarApp+PieCharts.swift to keep MenuBarApp.swift under 1000 lines.
Codex live windows with present but invalid values report invalid_response per design 'Derived Model'; the session fallback keeps dropping bad events because its contract is never-throw.
The old combined rl-09 was split so the build-cache-owning gate (rl-12) is isolated in the last wave with explicit artifactRoots.
intentionalTradeoffs: CCUsageGaugeMenuBar has no unit-test target; rl-10 is verified by compilation, lint, line counts, grep ordering checks and recorded inspection, and the GUI glyph check may be skipped with a reason.
The live /api/rate-limits smoke check may be skipped without an owned service lifecycle; non-disclosure is proven by RateLimitUsageIntegrationTests.
rl-09 and rl-11 share wave 1 in one working tree, so swift build may break transiently; overview rule 4 applies and rl-12 reruns the full gate.
Tool versions (swift, bun, node) are not captured in an audit manifest; frontend/bun.lock with --frozen-lockfile pins frontend provenance.
The combined rl-01 to rl-08 baseline has not been built in this run; a failure surfaces at rl-09/rl-11 step 1 or the rl-12 gate and goes to serial repair or a checkpoint amendment.
supportedEdgeCases: Default [budget] menu-bar selection: no current() call, byte-identical glyph, unchanged dropdown.
refresh() with a nil machineSnapshotStore or failed snapshot still reaches refreshRateLimitsIfNeeded().
Pie toggle persists via mutateState and updates the glyph without scheduling an extra refresh.
Second /api/rate-limits call within 60 s served from the throttle cache with no additional upstream request.
Codex window with negative used_percent or non-positive limit_window_seconds throws invalidResponse; one invalid window invalidates the whole response; a window missing either field is still dropped.
Codex weekly-only primary with null secondary yields fiveHour nil and weekly used 82.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Rate limits for remote machines or extra per-machine Codex session directories (QA decision 4).
Refreshing expired tokens on behalf of the CLIs.
Syncing the dashboard and menu-bar pie selections.
Rate-limit polling when menu-bar bootstrap fails (no-data ring is accepted).
